note: Founded 2011 by Joris Poort (CEO) and Adam McKenzie (CTO), went through YC Winter 2012. By 2022 Wikipedia (citing a 2023 press release) reported Rescale had raised over $200M and reached a >$1B valuation, calling it 'the first unicorn company in cloud high performance computing' -- this predates and is superseded by the confirmed April 2025 $115M Series D bringing total funding to >$260M.
